name: Weather
reason: Folks, it's a dry, calm late-October week, but with highs averaging only 18.5C and not a single day near 30C, the water just isn't getting the heat that blooms need to really take off.
evidence: max_temp_avg 18.5C, well below the 30C bloom-favouring threshold
rain_total_mm 0.7, so little flushing or mixing from rain, which only partly offsets the cool temperatures
